title: Mixed Event — Don't lose faith!

meta.Outline: Now that Shiho has passionately declared that they'll let their music do the talking, she and the rest of Leo/need decide to ramp up their practice in the month leading up to their next show. When that proves to be insufficient, Shiho proposes an intense training program in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: With this song...

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We have one month until our next show...)

rows.Line: (We need to get this song perfect by then.)

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki wrote, “It hurts,” and “I hate this so much,” in her songwriting notebook. She even had, “I don't want tomorrow to come”...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (All these things that I can't imagine her saying. And they were scrawled with so much pain that you could feel it just from looking.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She was carrying all this pain and all these memories that I didn't know about...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But she said the message I sent helped her get through that, even though my original intention was to chat for a bit...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, these lyrics won't do...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (All I did was just wrote down Saki's words and arranged them to the melody of the song.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Which means there's no point in me writing these lyrics...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I have to use my own words.
I need to take her feelings from this song and tell everyone what's really going on...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It wasn't easy, but I managed to finish them, and I really like how they turned out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Line: Mind showing us what you wrote...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here they are...

rows.Line: Wh-What do you think...?

rows.Line:

rows.Line: They're incredible, Ichi...

rows.Line: A lot of words and thoughts came to mind as I wrote my song, but I couldn't string them together very well.

rows.Line: The lyrics you wrote make so much sense. It's like you knew exactly what I was thinking.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. Not only that, your lyrics helped turn my song into our song. Leo/need's song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So... I'm really, really glad that you were the one who wrote the lyrics for us again this time, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Me too!
I can't wait to practice it and play it in front of people!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, about that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
...

rows.Line: Is that how people see us...?

rows.Line: Our performances still need work, and our songs didn't resonate with that crowd during our last show...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I wanna show everyone what we're really made of at our next show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's like what Shiho told Saku...
I want our music to do the talking for us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, we worked super duper hard on our latest song just for the crowd at that live house... And it turned out this well because we put a ton of thought into it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, I'm really confident about it!
I'm sure everyone at that live house...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Everyone who hears this song is gonna be blown away by it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saku said that we're “a band made up of high school girls through and through” because our music didn't strike a chord with her.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
However, with Saki's new song...
I'm sure that audience, as well as Saku, will understand what Leo/need's all about.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I'm also going to do everything I can for our next show. I want to prove to everyone that we're not going pro just for fun...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sounds like you're all in agreement.

rows.Line: But Shih, you really put yourself out there by saying that you girls are gonna show everyone what this band's all about with your music!

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. Also...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If you didn't speak up, Shiho, I probably would've said something.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Atta girl.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone.

rows.Line: Alright, that means we've really gotta practice...!

rows.Line: This song has a different melody and tempo compared to what we usually play, so we may want to start by individually mastering how to play it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, I came up with practice schedules that should allow us to efficiently make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, for all of us?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, here.
I made copies for all of us, so if you don't mind taking a look.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! Way to go, Shih! You're always so reliable!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Impressive...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If we can get through this, we should be able to put on a perfect show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it does!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree...!
I'd like to give it a try as well!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, let's all do our best until our next show.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Honami
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Again, a month probably isn't enough time for us to play this song in a way that really moves everyone in that crowd.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(But I'm not backing down.
Not after what we were told that time...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm gonna do absolutely everything I can until the day of our show. I have to support everyone somehow...)

rows.Speaker: Rin

rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
...!
Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Still, we're so blessed...
We essentially each get to have our own personal tutors.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:

Let's do everything we can so that we'll be ready for our next show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. That means we'll have to do our best to make that goal a reality.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, we really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO

rows.Line: Alright, let's get started with our first day of training...

rows.Line: Oh, since this is our first day, I'd like to start by explaining what we'll actually be doing.

rows.Line: As you all probably know already, our next show is roughly one month from now and we'll be practicing in preparation for that...

rows.Line: For the next two weeks, Miku and the others will be working with us one-on-one to raise our skill levels for the instruments we each play. Then, for the following two weeks until our show, we'll be working on playing as a band.

rows.Speaker: Saki

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sounds like a plan.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yup!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think we'll know then just how much we've improved individually...

rows.Speaker: Saki

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is so exciting! It's like the story in a manga I borrowed from Tsukasa a while back!

rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's one of your most endearing qualities, Saki...

rows.Line: But please don't forget that we absolutely have to make our next show a success.

rows.Speaker: Shiho

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But, at the same time... I still want us to have fun...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, Leo/need isn't really about sad songs like the one we're working on right now. I believe we're a band that should be playing fun and exciting music!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As important as practicing is, we can't forget that we're trying to reach others through our music.

rows.Speaker: Shiho

rows.Speaker: anemone Member A
rows.Line:
Saku?
Hey, Earth to Saku!

rows.Speaker: anemone Member B
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's not gonna work.
We're probably not getting Saku back for a while.

rows.Speaker: anemone Member A
rows.Line:
What?!
But we're up next!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
...
Nicely done.
Live House

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: Today's show was good...

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line:
Yeah, it really was.
Especially...

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: anemone for one, but also Leo/need. They were so different compared to before. I didn't know they had a song like that up their sleeves.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We did it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That was sooo much fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, it was.
The audience also really seemed to have enjoyed our performance.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Great show, girls.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Miku...!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Thanks for inviting us to see your show! Also, thanks for finding such a great spot to place your phone! We got a perfect view of your entire set!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you sure? We ended up choosing a pretty dark spot.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, that didn't bother us at all! It was great! Even after seeing you girls practice so much, today's performance was the best!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<She's right.
Remembering just how much you all practiced even made me tear up a little.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Not only that, the audience seemed to really respond to your performance.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that was a huge relief...
I'm so glad we were able to get through to them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They responded especially well to your new song, Saki. I saw them turn their faces towards us one by one to really listen as we played...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I even started trying to do more to make sure we got through to them...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe that because of how hard we all worked.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'm glad you were also able to play at 100%, Shiho...>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Me too...
And I have you to thank for that, KAITO. I really appreciate you teaching me so much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <All we really did was provide support for you girls. You were able to put on such an incredible performance because you put in the work.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes, you all worked so hard for this.
As both a fellow performer and a member of the audience, I was blown away by your performance today.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it really was an incredible show... Actually, I think it was our best one yet! But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We couldn't really hold a candle to anemone.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even after our set ended, the crowd kept cheering for a pretty long time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It showed that we put on a really incredible performance. We all probably thought that just maybe our song resonated more with them than anemone's music...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We couldn't get up to their level...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They played such a turbulent song with everything they had... It was so different compared to what we heard last time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But they connected with the audience...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It just goes to show how amazing Saku is...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I think we can feel proud of the way we played...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We managed to put on a fun performance, gave it everything we had and even got the audience going...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We did what we set out to do, and found out that people want to hear our music...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I believe this show was a huge success!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Absolutely!
Also, those training sessions seemed really hard, but you all got through them! So, the MVP this time around is... Shih!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Because you came up with training schedules and stuff for all of us!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not only that, Shiho, you played like you really meant it. I think we were able to put on such a great performance because of that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree. We couldn't actually reach your level in such a short period of time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But we'll keep doing what we can.
And our next show's going to be just as incredible as the one we put on today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was able to play that way because you all said you're prepared for that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, thanks for telling me that I shouldn't hold back.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't think I've ever had so much fun playing in a show before...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...
Yes, I had fun as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wait, that's...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<H-Hey!
We gotta hide!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saku...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: That was a good performance.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Lately, the events that I've been doing haven't been all that interesting, including band battles...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: But today was different. I actually felt excited, and was able to put on a great show because of that.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
Saki, right?
I liked your new song. It really hit home with me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
And your performance...
You got pretty emotional here and there...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: But that matched this song perfectly. I feel that it shouldn't be played any other way...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: It made me think, “Ah, so this is what Leo/need's all about.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're glad to hear that you liked it so much...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: So, I was wondering...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
When are you playing next?
If possible, I'd like it if you could tell me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: This event turned out to be a really good one, yes? I was thinking that we could do another one together.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Oh, I'd also like to swap contact information with you. That should make it easier for us to find a suitable date.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: H-Hang on...

rows.Speaker: anemone Member A
rows.Line: Aha, there you are! What are you doing here, Saku?!

rows.Speaker: anemone Member A
rows.Line:
Are you teasing these girls again?!
Seriously, you've gotta stop doing this! We're going! Now!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
Huh?
Wait, I just wanted to swap contact info...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There they go...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Ugh! Did that person honestly just run off without apologizing for what happened last time?!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I wouldn't get your hopes up. That's just who Saku seems to be...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, we heard something more important than an apology.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Right, Saki...?
Saku really seemed to like your new song...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: S-Saki? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
S-Sorry! Nothing's wrong...!
I-I'm really glad is all...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm glad I worked so hard on it...
And I'm really glad that it resonated with everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It was obvious based on your collective sound, but you girls really did play as a single unit today. It's no wonder your show was so incredible.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Right...
This show became a precious reminder of what Leo/need's music is actually about.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, I want us to never forget what we felt today and keep doing our best moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Honami
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Hehe...
I have a feeling that they're going to just keep growing and growing.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, I agree...>

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: Man, that was such a good show.

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: I came to see anemone like always, but it looked like Saku was really affected by the way Leo/need played...

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: It's rare for anemone to play a song like that here. It almost felt like they were going head-to-head... I kinda want to see them do another battle of the bands...
(I came here to see anemone after hearing that all these other agencies were trying to sign them...)
(But Leo/need... They're a nice surprise...)
